caseNameFull: Johnson v. Singletary, Secretary, Florida Department of Corrections
judges: Blackmun, Connor, Consideration, Grant, Light, Remand, Vacate, Whitley

opinions.text:
C. A. 11th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Justice Blackmun, Justice O’Connor, and Justice Souter would grant the petition, vacate the judgment, and remand the case for further consideration in light of Sawyer v. Whitley, 505 U. S. 333 (1992).
